g.text: Two State Machines: a Worker Claims a Job, a Player Picks a Quality
Left: RenditionStatus never shows a half-finished state. Right: buffer health is checked before throughput, not after.
promote() is the atomic staging-key -> final-key rename -- a crash before it completes just means the
job retries; nothing partially-done is ever visible to a viewer's manifest request.
Buffer health is checked BEFORE throughput -- protecting against a stall always outranks picking
